inheritance: Orientation, display, phyllary/spine, stickiness, trait-completion priorities and the three-discrete-module H2/H3 result are inherited unchanged from v2 unless overridden below.

colour.exact_continuous_coverage: 14/38 Japan38 concepts; six concepts have >=5 colour-usable observations and five have >=10
colour.continuous_history: LAB lightness is stably anti-phylogenetic at higher evidence depth: n>=5 patristic distance vs absolute lightness difference rho=-0.7071 with exact two-sided p=0.04444; n>=10 rho=-0.8545 with exact two-sided p=0.00833. Chroma and circular hue do not show the same stable pattern.
colour.separate_species_level_climate_gate: Negative: BIO1/BIO4/BIO12/BIO15 distance does not explain lightness overdispersion.

paired_same_cohort_gate.evidence: Environment is reconstructed from the same strict-spatial colour-usable observations that produce the exact species lightness medians.
paired_same_cohort_gate.decision: Current same-cohort climate, topography, and their combined distance do not explain the anti-phylogenetic lightness placement.

soil.blocker: JPN_17 C. maritimum has only four soil-linked colour observations, so the six-concept n>=5 set cannot be preserved.
soil.status: coverage-limited exploratory lead only; not a supported mechanism

colour.status: continuous history executed; high-depth lightness is anti-phylogenetic; both separate-layer and same-cohort current climate gates are negative; topography is negative; soil is unresolved by coverage; discrete colour transition history remains gated

cross_module.simple_common_lability_H3: not supported by the current three discrete historical modules
cross_module.colour_implication: Continuous lightness adds a non-conservative trait dimension but is not forced into the discrete Sankoff/Mk overlap because no justified discrete colour-state ontology is frozen.

colour_mechanism: Recover or derive radiation/rsds, VPD/aridity and wind/sfcWind on the exact high-depth concepts before claiming abiotic mechanism.
Increase soil-linked colour coverage, especially JPN_17, before repeating a depth-replicated soil gate.
After current abiotic axes are exhausted, test historical climate, biotic interactions and population-level colour variation.
next_actions.discrete_colour_history: Do not invent a C/W threshold; fixed-white lineage recovery and a biologically justified state ontology remain required for loss/regain questions.
next_actions.display: Still blocked by only 5/38 exact concepts sharing one comparable direct size metric; prioritize JPN_36, JPN_06, JPN_34, JPN_15 and JPN_24.

claim_boundary: Independent Japan38 compatibility reconstruction plus source-backed trait and same-cohort observational diagnostics. The paired gate reduces evidence-layer mismatch but does not establish adaptation or convergence. The tree is substitutions/site rather than dated time; soil coverage is uneven; radiation, VPD/aridity and wind are absent from the paired source artifact.
